entries.title: No second answer card while a crewmate works on your question
entries.body: When you send a question and then a correction, the work your first mate starts now counts for both, so it no longer posts a second answer card of its own. When a crewmate passes something to your first mate before showing its card, your first mate now leaves the answer to that card.
entries.noPicture: This stops a repeated answer card; no view or control looks different.
